data.body: [P1] Preserve the durable context across the retry backoff. If the wait completes in-process while another operation keeps the invocation active, this continuation runs on the completion/polling thread. `executeRetryLoop` then reads thread-local durable and extension contexts that were detached when the child returned its incomplete stage, causing `IllegalStateException` instead of attempt 2. Pass the captured contexts through the loop or restore both around this continuation, and add an integration test with a retrying branch and an active sibling.
